context: WordPress theme 'acme' (PHP 8.2, no build step for PHP). Frontend assets in assets/ built with Vite + Tailwind (npm run build). Follow WordPress Coding Standards; escape all output; text domain 'acme'.

tasks.title: REST endpoint for the contact form
tasks.prompt: Register POST /wp-json/acme/v1/contact in inc/rest-contact.php. Fields: name (required), email (required, is_email), message (required, max 2000 chars). Verify the wp_rest nonce, rate-limit to 5 requests per IP per hour with a transient, send with wp_mail() to get_option('admin_email'). Return {ok:true} or a WP_Error with status 400/429. Require the file from functions.php is NOT your job - the master wires it.

tasks.title: Contact section + form UI
tasks.prompt: Create template-parts/contact.php: a responsive two-column contact section (left: heading, short text, address/phone placeholders; right: the form). Tailwind classes only. Add assets/js/contact.js that submits the form with fetch() to /wp-json/acme/v1/contact, sends the X-WP-Nonce header from window.acmeContact.nonce, shows inline field errors and a success message, and disables the button while sending. Accessible labels, aria-live for messages.

tasks.title: Wire endpoint + assets into the theme
tasks.prompt: In functions.php require inc/rest-contact.php, enqueue assets/js/contact.js only on pages using template-parts/contact.php, and wp_localize_script it as acmeContact with a wp_rest nonce.
